name: Textbook max-flow (unit Day 2)
description: The six-node worked example from the flow-networks unit, authored so that Edmonds-Karp is forced to undo one of its own decisions. Iteration 1 pushes 3 along s->A->B->t and iteration 2 pushes 2 along s->C->B->t; with no forward path left, iteration 3 walks the residual graph s->C->B->A->D->t, traversing the backward arc B->A and cancelling 2 of the 3 units it had committed to A->B. Maximum flow 7; the minimum cut {B->t, A->D} also has capacity 7, certifying optimality. s is the sole supply and t the sole demand, with quantities set high so the lane capacities are what bind. NOTE: the order of the edges array is load-bearing -- see below.
